synopsis: Brazil’s NR-22 covers occupational safety and health in mining, alongside NR-12’s machinery safety role [f15578, f15579, f2797]. NR-22 was last modified on 29 January 2026, with Chapter 3 identifying the modifying instrument as Portaria MTE 105 [f2286, f2796]. Together, NR-22 and NR-12 establish general machine, mining, brake and operating requirements [f15579, f2288, f2798]. However, the reviewed Brazilian texts yielded no automatic-braking mandate, specifically no ISO 21815-style mandate with prescribed target or speed tests; this is a review finding rather than evidence that general brake requirements are absent [f2289, f2799, f2798].
